name: F1/F2 completion authorization and inherited work identity

files_modify.purpose: Preserve task authorization and compare inherited index/worktree endpoints across complete scope projections.
Executable disposable Git regressions proving F1/F2 defects and preservation controls.

non_goals: F3/F4 proof-validation changes; separate reviewed contract follows.
Installed .nizam changes, lifecycle/run_state ownership, remote publication, merge, release, deployment or provider effects.
Changing source identity based solely on a final worktree hash; following inherited symlinks; silently upgrading legacy task bases.

acceptance_requirements.requirement: Completion passes recorded contract identity by keyword into eligibility and revalidates identity, current approved/implemented/complete status and allowed scope; begin success never replaces current approval checks.

Version-2 bases bind route, task identity, normalized declared scope and contract identity; completion rejects missing, substituted or inapplicable authorization. Legacy records needing absent authorization proof require a fresh task ID.

At begin record separate versioned observations for every inherited endpoint: index stage/object/mode and no-follow worktree presence/kind/content SHA256 or literal symlink target plus executable mode. Refuse unsafe/unobservable inherited exceptions.

At done reobserve every original endpoint even absent from current porcelain. Unchanged inherited endpoints may remain exempt; any altered endpoint outside scope is refused, including staged contents, deletion/restoration, executable changes, links, untracked files and both rename/copy endpoints.

Scope accounting unions base-to-HEAD committed, HEAD-to-index staged, index-to-worktree unstaged and untracked paths, using --no-renames for all diff projections. Cancellation in a later layer never hides earlier undeclared changes.

Never overwrite or synthesize initial observations for existing bases. Legacy bases may finish only when no inherited exception or missing authorization proof is required; otherwise refuse with fresh task ID guidance.

Preserve unchanged inherited work, approved schema bugfix completion, existing task-owned evidence exclusions, ordinary clean non-feature routes and non-Git local behavior. No installed payload changes.

verification.detail: Add discriminating disposable repository cases: approved and rejected contract controls; revoked/substituted contract; inherited tracked/untracked/index/mode/link/rename changes; vanished original endpoint; unchanged inherited control; committed/staged/worktree cancellation; malformed/legacy bases. Before implementation, capture tests-only run with observed F1/F2 failures.

verification.detail: Executable exact role-owned artifacts/families guard across committed/staged/worktree/untracked paths. Shared run_state is Orchestrator-only; reviewers inspect its diff to verify ownership. No generic .agent exclusion.

evidence_convention: Exclusive execution records and raw stdout/stderr named per role/check/attempt; no overwrites.
authority_note: Fresh local contract; no copied historical approval is claimed. User override is limited to defective completion/proof controls being repaired.
